To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the optimal code for deblurring is not necessarily the one optimized for PSF estimation, that the code optimized for PSF invertability can lead to poor PSF estimation, and that a code optimized for PSFI estimation can lead to a code for PSF inversion.
(1) The optimal code for PSFs invertibility could worsens PSF estimation; and (2) The optimal code can be designed to have good PSFs estimation capability.
the optimal coded exposure code is the one which maximizes the PSF estimation quality and minimizes the PSF invertibility error, subject to a maximum code length constraint.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of codes that are optimized to meet both criteria of PSF invertiblity and PSF estimation, for better deconvolution performance.
the design of codes that can improve deconvolution of moving objects in a single image.
the problem of single-image deblurring of objects in motion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a coded exposure camera with an optimal code is better than the traditional camera for single image motion deblurring, and the proposed codes are superior to the existing codes.
the proposed code outperforms the code designed only for PSF invertability in terms of PSF estimation and deconvolution noise.
a code optimized for PSF estimation would perform better in terms of both image quality and deconvolution noise, compared to a code optimized only for PSF invertability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel design of codes for coded exposure, which is optimized for PSF estimation, and hence for deconvolution.
a coded exposure camera can be optimized for both PSF invertibility as well as PSF estimation, and this would result in improved deblurring performance.
the proposed codes can achieve the same level of deconvolution performance as codes optimized for PSF invertiblity but with better PSF estimation capability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the code for PSF estimation should be different from the code for PSFs that are invertible.
the optimal code design should be based on both PSF estimation and PSF invertibility.
the design of codes for motion de-blurring should be done by optimizing for both PSF invertibility (to reduce noise) and PSF estimation (to improve the quality of the de-blurred image).
